purpose: Identifies the exact dataset behind the published study so results can be checked even if the data files are not distributed.

dataset.adjustment: Split- and dividend-adjusted OHLC (all four fields scaled by AdjClose/Close). A total-return-oriented research proxy, not executable historical quotes.

schema.layout: one CSV per field; rows = session dates (column 'date'); columns = tickers; empty cell = no observation

rights.note: Derived from Yahoo Finance via the yfinance library. Yahoo's terms permit personal use and do not grant redistribution rights. Treat as private: do not publish these files without confirming rights.

without_the_private_dataset: `python experiments/trend_vs_buyhold.py` downloads the same tickers and dates from Yahoo. Adjusted prices drift over time (1.3e-6 relative was observed within hours; larger after each dividend), so figures agree to roughly four significant digits, not bit for bit. `--verify` reports the difference.
